titre: Exercices — L'irréel et les hypothèses (conditionnels mixtes)
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 1 : « If you (to touch) that wire, you (to get) an electric shock. »
corrige: Proposition en if → présent : touch.
Conséquence probable → will + BV : will get.
exercices.reponse: If you touch that wire, you will get an electric shock.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 2 : « If I (to be) you, I (to accept) the offer. »
corrige: Irréel du présent → prétérit, et were à toutes les personnes : were.
Principale → would + BV : would accept.
exercices.reponse: If I were you, I would accept the offer.

exercices.enonce: Complète au type 3 : « If she (to take) the earlier flight, she (not / to be) stuck here. »
corrige: Proposition en if → past perfect : had taken.
Principale → would have + PP : wouldn't have been.
exercices.reponse: If she had taken the earlier flight, she wouldn't have been stuck here.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la faute : « If I would have more money, I would buy a house. »
corrige: On n'emploie jamais would dans la proposition en if.
Type 2 → prétérit : If I had more money.
exercices.reponse: If I had more money, I would buy a house.

exercices.enonce: Construis un mixte passé→présent : « I didn't learn to drive. (conséquence maintenant : I can't get to work easily.) »
corrige: Condition passée → past perfect : If I had learned to drive.
Conséquence présente → would + BV : I would get to work more easily now.
exercices.reponse: If I had learned to drive, I would get to work more easily now.

exercices.enonce: Exprime un regret présent : « I don't speak Chinese. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Regret sur le présent → wish + prétérit.
I wish I spoke Chinese.

exercices.enonce: Exprime un regret passé : « I sold my old bike. Now I regret it. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Regret sur le passé → wish + past perfect.
I wish I hadn't sold my old bike.
exercices.reponse: I wish I hadn't sold my old bike.

exercices.enonce: Exprime l'agacement : « My neighbour plays loud music every night. → I wish ___ . »
corrige: Souhait de changement de comportement d'autrui → wish + would.
I wish my neighbour would stop playing loud music.
exercices.reponse: I wish my neighbour would stop playing loud music.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Il est grand temps que tu prennes une décision » et « Je préférerais que tu ne partes pas ».
corrige: It's (high) time + prétérit : It's high time you made a decision.
would rather + sujet + prétérit : I'd rather you didn't leave.
exercices.reponse: It's high time you made a decision. / I'd rather you didn't leave.

exercices.enonce: Relie réel et irréel : « He was rude, so I didn't help him. Rewrite as a type 3 sentence expressing what would have changed. »
corrige: Condition passée → past perfect : If he hadn't been so rude.
Conséquence passée → would have + PP : I would have helped him.
exercices.reponse: If he hadn't been so rude, I would have helped him.
